name: DominoPost – Advanced Post Editor, Free AI Writer, AI Connector (MCP Server), Complete SEO Suite & Rank Tracker
author: Dominopress

sections.description:
DominoPost is the ultimate all-in-one productivity, AI content creation, and search optimization powerhouse for WordPress publishers, bloggers, and digital agencies. It eliminates the need for 5+ separate plugins by bringing together seven primary powerhouse pillars into one blazingly fast interface:

  1. 📝 Advanced Post Editor: Classic Editor & TinyMCE power tools, Table Builder, Pro Table of Contents (TOC), Site-Wide Broken Link Checker, Bulk Title Editor, Emoji Picker, and real-time content analysis metrics.
  2. 🤖 Advanced AI Writer Studio: Blazingly fast streaming content generation supporting Bulk Production, Topic Clustering (pillar articles with LSI keywords), Anti-AI Cliché Filter (Humanizer), Interactive Outline Architect, Drip Publishing, and live terminal with instant stop/abort controls. Powered by Google Gemini (Default), Groq (Meta Llama), Cerebras, OpenAI, and OpenRouter.
  3. 🔌 Autonomous AI Connector (MCP Server): Official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server enabling ChatGPT, Claude.ai, Claude Desktop, Cursor IDE, and Antigravity to manage WordPress drafts, posts, SEO, and media via 15 built-in tools with zero-token OAuth 2.1 & CIMD.
  4. 🎯 Complete SEO Suite & Advanced Sitemaps: Rank Math PRO-caliber SEO suite featuring Multi-Schema JSON-LD, Master SEO Compatibility Switch, Smart 404 Auto-Redirects by slug similarity, Video & Google News XML Sitemaps, Instant IndexNow submission, granular On-Page Robots & Canonical controls, and WooCommerce SEO Pro with Google Merchant Schema & Category Base Stripper.
  5. 📊 Specific Keywords Rank Tracker & SEO Audit: Dedicated Rank Tracker dashboard syncing exact keyword positions with Google Search Console, timeline tracking, position delta indicators (gainers/losers), 1-click tracking from the post editor, and automated Site-Wide SEO Audits with health scoring.
  6. 📱 Live Social Previews & Post Redirections: Live visual Facebook Open Graph and X (Twitter) Card preview cards in the post editor, plus a post-level redirection manager supporting 301, 302, 307, 410 (Gone), and 451 (Legal) status codes with hit logging.
  7. 🖼️ Image SEO & Smart Link Building: Ported Autobute engine with automated bulk alt text, title, caption, and description generation with customizable SEO templates and filename sanitization, plus an automated keyword linking rules engine and orphan posts rescue.

👉 Unlock the Full Power of DominoPost PRO Here

💎 DominoPost PRO: The Advanced AI Suite

Upgrade your content game with the DominoPost PRO Addon, featuring our most advanced automation engines:
* ⚡ AI Smart Semantic Internal Interlinker: Automatically scans your site and inserts high-relevance internal links with natural context-aware anchor text.
* 🌐 Smart AI External Link Placement: Paste any external or affiliate URL and let AI discover the perfect spot to insert it naturally.
* ✨ AI Smart Rewrite (Magic Wand): Select any sentence or paragraph to instantly rewrite it with 4 professional tones (Friendly, Creative, Professional, Concise).
* ❓ AI FAQ Schema Generator: Generate interactive FAQ blocks with automated JSON-LD Schema to capture Google’s “People Also Ask” rich snippets.
* ✍️ 1-Click AI Grammar & Tone Polisher: Instantly clean up typos, passive voice, and phrasing across your entire post with a single click.
* 🎯 Unlimited AI Generations & Bulk Article Expansion: Generate long-form articles in bulk without daily throttling.

🎯 Complete SEO Suite: Rank Math PRO-Caliber Search Optimization (FREE)

DominoPost delivers a modular, professional SEO engine designed to rival Rank Math PRO and Yoast:
* Modular Control Center: Toggle features on/off per your site’s needs (Rank Tracker, Sitemaps, Webmaster Tools, Redirections, Instant Indexing, Image SEO, Schema, SEO Audit) directly inside admin.php?page=dominopost-seo with zero bloat.
* Master SEO Compatibility Switch: 1-click global enable/disable switch allowing you to seamlessly run DominoPost’s AI Writer, Post Editor, or MCP Server alongside existing plugins like Yoast, Rank Math, or All in One SEO with zero conflicts.
* Multi-Schema JSON-LD Graph: Google-compliant unified @graph structured data supporting Article, BlogPosting, NewsArticle, LocalBusiness, FAQPage, and WooCommerce Product nodes.
* Smart 404 Auto-Redirects by Slug Similarity: Intercepts 404 broken URLs and calculates Levenshtein similarity against live content slugs, cleanly 301-redirecting users when similarity exceeds your configured threshold (default: 75%).
* Post-Level Redirections: Built-in redirection manager supporting 301 (Permanent), 302 (Found), 307 (Temporary), 410 (Gone), and 451 (Unavailable for Legal Reasons) redirects directly inside the post editor with hit tracking.
* Live Social Share Previews: Visualize exactly how your content will look when shared on Facebook (Open Graph) and X (Twitter Card) directly within the post editor SEO metabox.
* Granular On-Page Editor Controls: Primary focus keyword plus up to 4 Secondary Keywords (100% free) evaluated in real time across title, headings, URL, and body, advanced robots directives (nosnippet, max-image-preview:large, noarchive), and custom Canonical URL overrides.
* AI-Native SEO Intelligence: 1-Click AI JSON-LD Schema Synthesizer, AI Content Decay & Staleness Refresher, and Contextual Bidirectional Internal Link Suggester.
* Instant IndexNow Submission: 1-click automatic API key generation with instant pinging to Bing, Yandex, and IndexNow endpoints whenever posts are published or updated.

📊 Specific Keywords Rank Tracker: Live Search Console Tracking (FREE)

Track exact search query performance right inside your WordPress admin:
* Live Google Search Console Synchronization: Pulls live average position, impressions, and click data for your designated target keywords without expensive third-party subscriptions.
* Position Delta Badges: Spot upward and downward ranking momentum instantly with directional indicators (+3, -2, NEW).
* Executive KPI Cards: Monitor Top 3 rankings, Top 10 rankings, Average Position, and Total Keywords Tracked at a glance.
* Historical Timeline Chart: Track position trajectories across 7-day, 30-day, and 90-day intervals to verify ranking gains.
* 1-Click Post Editor Tracking: Pin your primary focus keywords to the Rank Tracker with a single click inside the SEO metabox.

🔍 Site-Wide SEO Audit & Health Scoring (FREE)

  • Automated Health Score: Comprehensive automated health rating out of 100 inspecting titles, descriptions, canonicals, robots tags, and content depth.
  • Categorized Issues Breakdown: Immediate visibility into Critical Errors (broken canonicals, missing titles, 404s), Warnings (missing meta descriptions, thin content), and Good Checks across all published content.
  • Actionable Fixes: Clear instructions and direct 1-click edit links to resolve on-page optimization deficiencies rapidly.

🤖 Advanced AI Writer Studio: Bulk, Topic Clustering & Humanizer (FREE)

  • Bulk & Topic Clustering Modes: Produce standalone posts for each keyword line in Bulk Mode, or cluster secondary and LSI semantic keywords into an authoritative pillar article in Topic Clustering mode. Both modes support comma-separated or multi-line keyword pasting.
  • Anti-AI Cliché Filter (Humanizer): Ban cliché robotic phrases (“delve into”, “testament to”, “in this digital landscape”) for genuine, human-like voice.
  • Interactive Outline Architect: Preview, reorder, or edit structured heading blueprints before generating the full draft.
  • Granular Intent, Tone & POV Controls: Fine-tune Search Intent (Informational, Commercial, Transactional, Navigational), Tone & Voice, Point of View (Auto, First Person, Third Person), and Word Count targets (800w, 1200w, 1500w, 2500w+).
  • Automated Drip Publishing: Schedule bulk article rollouts automatically at custom hourly intervals into future drafts or scheduled posts.
  • Stock Image Insertion: Relevant Unsplash photos auto-inserted into content and set as featured images with intelligent keyword query sanitization.
  • Interactive Terminal with Abort & Stop: Live streaming terminal log with progress gauge, auto-scrolling log console, and instant Stop Generation / Close buttons powered by AbortController.
  • Multi-Engine Provider Support: Google Gemini (Default), Groq (Meta Llama), Cerebras AI, OpenAI, and OpenRouter with ultra-fast browser-side streaming bypassing server execution timeouts.

🔌 Autonomous AI Connector (Model Context Protocol / MCP Server – FREE)

Turn your WordPress blog into an AI-ready workspace! DominoPost implements the official Model Context Protocol (MCP) specification:
* Direct AI Assistant Integration: Connect your WordPress site directly to ChatGPT (Web), Claude.ai (Web), Claude Desktop, Cursor IDE, Google Antigravity, or custom agents via standard JSON-RPC 2.0 / MCP over secure HTTPS.
* 15 Built-in Autonomous WordPress Tools:
* get_site_info: Retrieve site health, active theme, WordPress version, and capabilities.
* list_posts & get_post: Search, filter, and inspect published or draft posts and pages.
* create_post, update_post & delete_post: Full content drafting, editing, and publishing.
* list_taxonomies: Retrieve all categories and tags.
* search_media: Query media library attachments and image URLs.
* get_sitemap_info: Inspect total indexed URLs and sitemap collections.
* get_seo_analytics: Inspect top queries, clicks, impressions, CTR, and search positions.
* get_webmaster_status: Check domain verification status across all search engines.
* ping_search_engines: Trigger live sitemap pings to Google and Bing.
* format_faq_schema: Generate styled DominoPost accordion HTML and valid JSON-LD schema.
* generate_toc_block: Generate styled Table of Contents blocks.
* scan_internal_links: Discover internal linking opportunities across post content.
* Zero-Token OAuth 2.1 & CIMD: 1-click authorization for ChatGPT (Web) and Claude.ai (Web). No manual API keys, secret tokens, or complex configuration files required.
* Granular Safety & Tool Annotations: Every tool includes RFC-compliant readOnlyHint and destructiveHint attributes so AI assistants prompt for explicit approval before modifying content.
* Token Management & Permissions: Built-in API token provisioning with granular Read-Only vs. Read/Write roles, secret key masking, and instant token revocation.

🖼️ Image SEO: Automated Bulk Image Attributes & Filename Cleaner (FREE)

Ported directly from our high-performance Autobute plugin, Image SEO solves missing image attributes forever:
* Dedicated Image SEO Center: Full management dashboard at admin.php?page=dominopost-image-seo.
* 1-Click Bulk Auto-Updater: Processes thousands of images in batches with zero server timeouts, automatically filling missing Alt Text, Image Title, Caption, and Description in seconds.
* Smart Dynamic Tags: Use %filename%, %post_title%, %post_category%, and %post_tag% tags to craft high-converting, search-optimized attributes.
* Filename Cleaner & Sanitizer: Strips hyphens, underscores, numbers, and camera junk (e.g., IMG_20261122_9876.jpg -> Running Shoes For Marathon).
* Automatic On-Upload Mode: Automatically populates SEO attributes on new media uploads seamlessly in the background.

🗺️ XML Sitemaps & Webmaster Verification Suite (FREE)

  • Automated XML Sitemaps: Generates root XML sitemap indexes (/sitemap.xml) and dedicated sub-sitemaps for Posts, Pages, Products, Categories, and Tags with Google Images metadata.
  • Video XML Sitemap (/video-sitemap.xml): Automatically extracts YouTube, Vimeo, and HTML5 video embeds with thumbnail locators, player locations, and durations for Google Video Search.
  • Google News XML Sitemap (/news-sitemap.xml): Strict compliance with Google News standards, surfacing published articles from the last 48 hours.
  • Interactive Visual XSL UI: Beautiful, human-readable browser layout with instant search/filter, breadcrumbs, category tabs, and modern styling.
  • Webmaster Verification Hub: Easily verify your domain with Google Search Console, Bing Webmaster Tools, Pinterest, Yandex Webmaster, Baidu, and Facebook Domain Verification without modifying theme files.

🛒 WooCommerce SEO Pro: Merchant Schema & Clean Permalinks (FREE)

  • Enhanced Google Merchant Product Schema: Complete WooCommerce product structured data containing Brand, itemCondition: NewCondition, priceValidUntil, availability: InStock/OutOfStock, and aggregateRating (star ratings and review count) for rich Google Shopping snippets.
  • Category Base Stripper: Cleanly strips /product-category/ from category permalinks (e.g., site.com/product-category/shoes/ -> site.com/shoes/) with automatic 301 redirects to preserve SEO equity.

🔗 Link Building Suite: Automated Internal Linking & Orphan Rescue (FREE)

  • Keyword Linking Rules: Map your core focus keywords to target URLs. The engine scans your published posts and creates links safely without manual editing.
  • Orphan Posts Rescue: Detects posts with zero inbound internal links and automatically pairs them with low-outbound posts, building a healthy internal link architecture without link stuffing.
  • Inbound & Outbound Ratio Health: Visual counters and live health indicators for internal links sent and received across your entire blog.

📈 SEO Analytics & GA4 Intelligence Hub (FREE)

  • SEO Analytics (Google Search Console): Real-time dashboard tracking Clicks, Impressions, CTR, and Average Position with automatic GSC API latency clamping.
  • Blogger Action Hub: Actionable intelligence surfacing Content Decay Radar (posts losing traffic), Striking Distance Keywords (positions 8–20 ready for Page 1), and Low CTR Headline Fixers.
  • Google Analytics 4 Dashboard: Realtime visitor monitor (live users, pages, countries), Content Engagement Matrix (Viral Hits, High Value Assets, Low Engagement Traffic, Under-promoted Gems), and Traffic Acquisition breakdowns.
  • SEO + Analytics Merged Intelligence: Directly cross-references GSC query rankings and impressions with GA4 reader engagement time and conversions per URL.

📝 Classic Editor & Productivity Power Tools (FREE)

  • Pro Table of Contents (TOC): 4 elegant styles (Bullets, Numbers, Minimal, Boxed) with smooth-scrolling, live preview, and Google-friendly semantic markup.
  • Site-Wide Broken Link Checker: Fast, automated link audits inside the Tools menu.
  • Bulk Title Editor Suite: Batch find-and-replace, title suffix additions, and manual overrides.
  • Editor Enhancements: In-article Find & Replace, Smart Related Posts, Update Reminders, Toolbar Emoji Picker, Table Builder, and real-time Sidebar SEO Analysis.

Why Choose DominoPost?

  1. Lightweight & Fast: Modular architecture built with zero bloat. Keeps your admin and site loading instantly.
  2. SEO-First Design: Engineered to boost organic rankings, maximize internal link equity, and improve search CTR.
  3. The Ultimate Classic Editor Alternative: If you love the speed and simplicity of the Classic Editor, DominoPost transforms it with modern React intelligence.

Credits

Developed by DominoPress – Making WordPress Content Creation Smarter, Faster, and more Human.
Visit us: https://dominopress.com
sections.installation:
1. Upload the dominopost-advanced-post-editor folder to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. (Optional) Install the DominoPost PRO Addon to unlock the advanced AI automation suite.
  4. Visit DominoPost Settings to configure your API key and default styles.
  5. Start creating world-class content!
sections.faq:
Can DominoPost coexist with other SEO plugins like Yoast or Rank Math?

Yes! DominoPost includes a Master SEO Compatibility Switch in the SEO Suite settings. If you already use Yoast, Rank Math, or All in One SEO, you can disable DominoPost’s SEO module with a single click while continuing to use the AI Writer Studio, Advanced Post Editor, AI Connector (MCP Server), Image SEO, and Link Building features without duplicate tags or conflicts.

What is the Specific Keywords Rank Tracker?

The Rank Tracker lets you monitor your most important focus keywords with live average search position, click counts, and impressions synchronized directly from Google Search Console. You can track position gains/losses with delta badges (+3, -1, NEW) and monitor ranking trends over 7, 30, and 90-day historical charts. You can also track any focus keyword with 1 click directly from the post editor.

How does the Site-Wide SEO Audit work?

The SEO Audit evaluates all your published posts and pages against critical search ranking criteria, providing an overall health rating out of 100. It groups issues into Critical Errors (missing titles, broken canonicals, 404s), Warnings (missing meta descriptions, thin word counts), and Good Checks, with direct links to fix each post.

What is Topic Clustering mode in the AI Writer?

Unlike Bulk Production (which generates one post per keyword line), Topic Clustering lets you input one primary pillar keyword plus a list of secondary and LSI semantic keywords. The AI then constructs an authoritative, comprehensive pillar article that organically weaves those semantic subtopics into H2/H3 subheadings and body paragraphs.

What is the Anti-AI Cliché Filter (Humanizer)?

The Humanizer actively scans and prevents overused AI buzzwords and robotic transitional clichés (such as “delve into”, “a testament to”, “in this fast-paced digital era”) from appearing in your generated articles, ensuring your content reads naturally and authentically to human readers and search engines.

Can I stop or cancel an ongoing AI generation?

Yes! The generation terminal popup features both an explicit “Stop Generation” button, a top-right close button, and Esc key support powered by browser-level AbortController. Stopping generation immediately halts the API request stream and cancels any remaining scheduled keywords.

What is the AI Connector / MCP Server?

The AI Connector implements the open Model Context Protocol (MCP) standard, enabling external AI clients (like ChatGPT Web, Claude.ai Web, Claude Desktop, and Cursor IDE) to securely communicate with your WordPress site. Through natural language in your AI chat, you can ask the AI to query posts, draft articles, format SEO schemas, inspect sitemaps, and ping search engines.

How do I connect ChatGPT (Web) or Claude.ai (Web) without an API token?

DominoPost features native OAuth 2.1 and Anthropic CIMD (Client Identity Metadata Documents) support. In ChatGPT or Claude.ai Web, simply paste your DominoPost MCP Server URL into the custom connector dialog. The AI client automatically discovers the authentication settings and establishes a secure connection with zero tokens or manual keys needed.

What search engines are supported in Webmaster Tools?

DominoPost supports 1-click verification meta tag injection for Google Search Console, Bing Webmaster Tools, Pinterest, Yandex Webmaster, Baidu, and Facebook Domain Verification. Simply paste your verification codes and DominoPost handles the rest.

Does the XML Sitemap engine replace third-party sitemap plugins?

Yes! DominoPost automatically generates Google-compliant XML sitemap indexes (/sitemap.xml) with dedicated sub-sitemaps for posts, pages, products, categories, and tags, complete with <image:image> tags for Google Images and automatic search engine pings. You do not need a separate XML sitemap plugin.

Are Google Search Console and Google Analytics 4 free?

Yes! Both SEO Analytics (Google Search Console) and Google Analytics 4 dashboards with the Blogger Action Hub and Engagement Matrix are 100% free with no tier locks.

How does the Orphan Posts Rescue work?

Orphan Posts Rescue identifies published posts with zero inbound internal links and connects them with posts that have sent zero or few outbound links, ensuring balanced distribution across your site without keyword stuffing.

Does it support Google Gemini, Groq, Cerebras, and OpenAI?

Yes! We support Google Gemini (2.5 Flash/Pro), Groq (Meta Llama), Cerebras AI, OpenRouter, and any OpenAI-compatible API key.

Is the Table of Contents SEO friendly?

Absolutely. Our TOC follows semantic HTML structures and uses clean IDs for perfect Google crawling.

Does the PRO Addon require the Free version?

Yes, the PRO Addon is an enhancement that plugs into the robust DominoPost core.

What is the Complete SEO Suite in DominoPost?

DominoPost now includes a complete, modular SEO engine modeled after Rank Math PRO. It handles multi-schema JSON-LD graphs, Smart 404 auto-redirects by slug similarity, on-page multi-focus keyword analysis, advanced robots directives, Instant IndexNow submission, Video XML sitemaps, Google News sitemaps, and WooCommerce SEO Pro with zero bloat.

How does Smart 404 Auto-Redirect by Slug Similarity work?

When a visitor or search crawler visits a URL that would normally trigger a 404 Not Found error, DominoPost extracts the slug and calculates its Levenshtein similarity against all published posts. If the match exceeds your set threshold (e.g. 75%), DominoPost issues a 301 Permanent Redirect directly to the correct article, eliminating 404 bounces and preserving link juice.

What is the Image SEO feature and how does it work?

Adapted from our proven Autobute plugin, Image SEO automatically generates optimized Alt Text, Image Title, Caption, and Description for all your WordPress media attachments using customizable dynamic tags like %filename%, %post_title%, and %post_category%. It includes a filename cleaner that converts file names like best-running-shoes-2026.jpg into clean, human-readable text.

How does WooCommerce SEO Pro enhance my store?

WooCommerce SEO Pro generates enhanced Google Merchant Product Schema containing Brand, itemCondition, priceValidUntil, and aggregateRating star reviews. It also includes an optional 1-click Category Base Stripper that removes /product-category/ from URLs while automatically 301-redirecting old paths.

short_description: Autonomous AI Connector (MCP Server), Advanced Post Editor, Free AI Writer, Complete SEO Suite, Rank Tracker, Sitemaps, and Image SEO.
description:
DominoPost is the ultimate all-in-one productivity, AI content creation, and search optimization powerhouse for WordPress publishers, bloggers, and digital agencies. It eliminates the need for 5+ separate plugins by bringing together seven primary powerhouse pillars into one blazingly fast interface:

  1. 📝 Advanced Post Editor: Classic Editor & TinyMCE power tools, Table Builder, Pro Table of Contents (TOC), Site-Wide Broken Link Checker, Bulk Title Editor, Emoji Picker, and real-time content analysis metrics.
  2. 🤖 Advanced AI Writer Studio: Blazingly fast streaming content generation supporting Bulk Production, Topic Clustering (pillar articles with LSI keywords), Anti-AI Cliché Filter (Humanizer), Interactive Outline Architect, Drip Publishing, and live terminal with instant stop/abort controls. Powered by Google Gemini (Default), Groq (Meta Llama), Cerebras, OpenAI, and OpenRouter.
  3. 🔌 Autonomous AI Connector (MCP Server): Official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server enabling ChatGPT, Claude.ai, Claude Desktop, Cursor IDE, and Antigravity to manage WordPress drafts, posts, SEO, and media via 15 built-in tools with zero-token OAuth 2.1 & CIMD.
  4. 🎯 Complete SEO Suite & Advanced Sitemaps: Rank Math PRO-caliber SEO suite featuring Multi-Schema JSON-LD, Master SEO Compatibility Switch, Smart 404 Auto-Redirects by slug similarity, Video & Google News XML Sitemaps, Instant IndexNow submission, granular On-Page Robots & Canonical controls, and WooCommerce SEO Pro with Google Merchant Schema & Category Base Stripper.
  5. 📊 Specific Keywords Rank Tracker & SEO Audit: Dedicated Rank Tracker dashboard syncing exact keyword positions with Google Search Console, timeline tracking, position delta indicators (gainers/losers), 1-click tracking from the post editor, and automated Site-Wide SEO Audits with health scoring.
  6. 📱 Live Social Previews & Post Redirections: Live visual Facebook Open Graph and X (Twitter) Card preview cards in the post editor, plus a post-level redirection manager supporting 301, 302, 307, 410 (Gone), and 451 (Legal) status codes with hit logging.
  7. 🖼️ Image SEO & Smart Link Building: Ported Autobute engine with automated bulk alt text, title, caption, and description generation with customizable SEO templates and filename sanitization, plus an automated keyword linking rules engine and orphan posts rescue.

👉 Unlock the Full Power of DominoPost PRO Here

💎 DominoPost PRO: The Advanced AI Suite

Upgrade your content game with the DominoPost PRO Addon, featuring our most advanced automation engines:
* ⚡ AI Smart Semantic Internal Interlinker: Automatically scans your site and inserts high-relevance internal links with natural context-aware anchor text.
* 🌐 Smart AI External Link Placement: Paste any external or affiliate URL and let AI discover the perfect spot to insert it naturally.
* ✨ AI Smart Rewrite (Magic Wand): Select any sentence or paragraph to instantly rewrite it with 4 professional tones (Friendly, Creative, Professional, Concise).
* ❓ AI FAQ Schema Generator: Generate interactive FAQ blocks with automated JSON-LD Schema to capture Google’s “People Also Ask” rich snippets.
* ✍️ 1-Click AI Grammar & Tone Polisher: Instantly clean up typos, passive voice, and phrasing across your entire post with a single click.
* 🎯 Unlimited AI Generations & Bulk Article Expansion: Generate long-form articles in bulk without daily throttling.

🎯 Complete SEO Suite: Rank Math PRO-Caliber Search Optimization (FREE)

DominoPost delivers a modular, professional SEO engine designed to rival Rank Math PRO and Yoast:
* Modular Control Center: Toggle features on/off per your site’s needs (Rank Tracker, Sitemaps, Webmaster Tools, Redirections, Instant Indexing, Image SEO, Schema, SEO Audit) directly inside admin.php?page=dominopost-seo with zero bloat.
* Master SEO Compatibility Switch: 1-click global enable/disable switch allowing you to seamlessly run DominoPost’s AI Writer, Post Editor, or MCP Server alongside existing plugins like Yoast, Rank Math, or All in One SEO with zero conflicts.
* Multi-Schema JSON-LD Graph: Google-compliant unified @graph structured data supporting Article, BlogPosting, NewsArticle, LocalBusiness, FAQPage, and WooCommerce Product nodes.
* Smart 404 Auto-Redirects by Slug Similarity: Intercepts 404 broken URLs and calculates Levenshtein similarity against live content slugs, cleanly 301-redirecting users when similarity exceeds your configured threshold (default: 75%).
* Post-Level Redirections: Built-in redirection manager supporting 301 (Permanent), 302 (Found), 307 (Temporary), 410 (Gone), and 451 (Unavailable for Legal Reasons) redirects directly inside the post editor with hit tracking.
* Live Social Share Previews: Visualize exactly how your content will look when shared on Facebook (Open Graph) and X (Twitter Card) directly within the post editor SEO metabox.
* Granular On-Page Editor Controls: Primary focus keyword plus up to 4 Secondary Keywords (100% free) evaluated in real time across title, headings, URL, and body, advanced robots directives (nosnippet, max-image-preview:large, noarchive), and custom Canonical URL overrides.
* AI-Native SEO Intelligence: 1-Click AI JSON-LD Schema Synthesizer, AI Content Decay & Staleness Refresher, and Contextual Bidirectional Internal Link Suggester.
* Instant IndexNow Submission: 1-click automatic API key generation with instant pinging to Bing, Yandex, and IndexNow endpoints whenever posts are published or updated.

📊 Specific Keywords Rank Tracker: Live Search Console Tracking (FREE)

Track exact search query performance right inside your WordPress admin:
* Live Google Search Console Synchronization: Pulls live average position, impressions, and click data for your designated target keywords without expensive third-party subscriptions.
* Position Delta Badges: Spot upward and downward ranking momentum instantly with directional indicators (+3, -2, NEW).
* Executive KPI Cards: Monitor Top 3 rankings, Top 10 rankings, Average Position, and Total Keywords Tracked at a glance.
* Historical Timeline Chart: Track position trajectories across 7-day, 30-day, and 90-day intervals to verify ranking gains.
* 1-Click Post Editor Tracking: Pin your primary focus keywords to the Rank Tracker with a single click inside the SEO metabox.

🔍 Site-Wide SEO Audit & Health Scoring (FREE)

  • Automated Health Score: Comprehensive automated health rating out of 100 inspecting titles, descriptions, canonicals, robots tags, and content depth.
  • Categorized Issues Breakdown: Immediate visibility into Critical Errors (broken canonicals, missing titles, 404s), Warnings (missing meta descriptions, thin content), and Good Checks across all published content.
  • Actionable Fixes: Clear instructions and direct 1-click edit links to resolve on-page optimization deficiencies rapidly.

🤖 Advanced AI Writer Studio: Bulk, Topic Clustering & Humanizer (FREE)

  • Bulk & Topic Clustering Modes: Produce standalone posts for each keyword line in Bulk Mode, or cluster secondary and LSI semantic keywords into an authoritative pillar article in Topic Clustering mode. Both modes support comma-separated or multi-line keyword pasting.
  • Anti-AI Cliché Filter (Humanizer): Ban cliché robotic phrases (“delve into”, “testament to”, “in this digital landscape”) for genuine, human-like voice.
  • Interactive Outline Architect: Preview, reorder, or edit structured heading blueprints before generating the full draft.
  • Granular Intent, Tone & POV Controls: Fine-tune Search Intent (Informational, Commercial, Transactional, Navigational), Tone & Voice, Point of View (Auto, First Person, Third Person), and Word Count targets (800w, 1200w, 1500w, 2500w+).
  • Automated Drip Publishing: Schedule bulk article rollouts automatically at custom hourly intervals into future drafts or scheduled posts.
  • Stock Image Insertion: Relevant Unsplash photos auto-inserted into content and set as featured images with intelligent keyword query sanitization.
  • Interactive Terminal with Abort & Stop: Live streaming terminal log with progress gauge, auto-scrolling log console, and instant Stop Generation / Close buttons powered by AbortController.
  • Multi-Engine Provider Support: Google Gemini (Default), Groq (Meta Llama), Cerebras AI, OpenAI, and OpenRouter with ultra-fast browser-side streaming bypassing server execution timeouts.

🔌 Autonomous AI Connector (Model Context Protocol / MCP Server – FREE)

Turn your WordPress blog into an AI-ready workspace! DominoPost implements the official Model Context Protocol (MCP) specification:
* Direct AI Assistant Integration: Connect your WordPress site directly to ChatGPT (Web), Claude.ai (Web), Claude Desktop, Cursor IDE, Google Antigravity, or custom agents via standard JSON-RPC 2.0 / MCP over secure HTTPS.
* 15 Built-in Autonomous WordPress Tools:
* get_site_info: Retrieve site health, active theme, WordPress version, and capabilities.
* list_posts & get_post: Search, filter, and inspect published or draft posts and pages.
* create_post, update_post & delete_post: Full content drafting, editing, and publishing.
* list_taxonomies: Retrieve all categories and tags.
* search_media: Query media library attachments and image URLs.
* get_sitemap_info: Inspect total indexed URLs and sitemap collections.
* get_seo_analytics: Inspect top queries, clicks, impressions, CTR, and search positions.
* get_webmaster_status: Check domain verification status across all search engines.
* ping_search_engines: Trigger live sitemap pings to Google and Bing.
* format_faq_schema: Generate styled DominoPost accordion HTML and valid JSON-LD schema.
* generate_toc_block: Generate styled Table of Contents blocks.
* scan_internal_links: Discover internal linking opportunities across post content.
* Zero-Token OAuth 2.1 & CIMD: 1-click authorization for ChatGPT (Web) and Claude.ai (Web). No manual API keys, secret tokens, or complex configuration files required.
* Granular Safety & Tool Annotations: Every tool includes RFC-compliant readOnlyHint and destructiveHint attributes so AI assistants prompt for explicit approval before modifying content.
* Token Management & Permissions: Built-in API token provisioning with granular Read-Only vs. Read/Write roles, secret key masking, and instant token revocation.

🖼️ Image SEO: Automated Bulk Image Attributes & Filename Cleaner (FREE)

Ported directly from our high-performance Autobute plugin, Image SEO solves missing image attributes forever:
* Dedicated Image SEO Center: Full management dashboard at admin.php?page=dominopost-image-seo.
* 1-Click Bulk Auto-Updater: Processes thousands of images in batches with zero server timeouts, automatically filling missing Alt Text, Image Title, Caption, and Description in seconds.
* Smart Dynamic Tags: Use %filename%, %post_title%, %post_category%, and %post_tag% tags to craft high-converting, search-optimized attributes.
* Filename Cleaner & Sanitizer: Strips hyphens, underscores, numbers, and camera junk (e.g., IMG_20261122_9876.jpg -> Running Shoes For Marathon).
* Automatic On-Upload Mode: Automatically populates SEO attributes on new media uploads seamlessly in the background.

🗺️ XML Sitemaps & Webmaster Verification Suite (FREE)

  • Automated XML Sitemaps: Generates root XML sitemap indexes (/sitemap.xml) and dedicated sub-sitemaps for Posts, Pages, Products, Categories, and Tags with Google Images metadata.
  • Video XML Sitemap (/video-sitemap.xml): Automatically extracts YouTube, Vimeo, and HTML5 video embeds with thumbnail locators, player locations, and durations for Google Video Search.
  • Google News XML Sitemap (/news-sitemap.xml): Strict compliance with Google News standards, surfacing published articles from the last 48 hours.
  • Interactive Visual XSL UI: Beautiful, human-readable browser layout with instant search/filter, breadcrumbs, category tabs, and modern styling.
  • Webmaster Verification Hub: Easily verify your domain with Google Search Console, Bing Webmaster Tools, Pinterest, Yandex Webmaster, Baidu, and Facebook Domain Verification without modifying theme files.

🛒 WooCommerce SEO Pro: Merchant Schema & Clean Permalinks (FREE)

  • Enhanced Google Merchant Product Schema: Complete WooCommerce product structured data containing Brand, itemCondition: NewCondition, priceValidUntil, availability: InStock/OutOfStock, and aggregateRating (star ratings and review count) for rich Google Shopping snippets.
  • Category Base Stripper: Cleanly strips /product-category/ from category permalinks (e.g., site.com/product-category/shoes/ -> site.com/shoes/) with automatic 301 redirects to preserve SEO equity.

🔗 Link Building Suite: Automated Internal Linking & Orphan Rescue (FREE)

  • Keyword Linking Rules: Map your core focus keywords to target URLs. The engine scans your published posts and creates links safely without manual editing.
  • Orphan Posts Rescue: Detects posts with zero inbound internal links and automatically pairs them with low-outbound posts, building a healthy internal link architecture without link stuffing.
  • Inbound & Outbound Ratio Health: Visual counters and live health indicators for internal links sent and received across your entire blog.

📈 SEO Analytics & GA4 Intelligence Hub (FREE)

  • SEO Analytics (Google Search Console): Real-time dashboard tracking Clicks, Impressions, CTR, and Average Position with automatic GSC API latency clamping.
  • Blogger Action Hub: Actionable intelligence surfacing Content Decay Radar (posts losing traffic), Striking Distance Keywords (positions 8–20 ready for Page 1), and Low CTR Headline Fixers.
  • Google Analytics 4 Dashboard: Realtime visitor monitor (live users, pages, countries), Content Engagement Matrix (Viral Hits, High Value Assets, Low Engagement Traffic, Under-promoted Gems), and Traffic Acquisition breakdowns.
  • SEO + Analytics Merged Intelligence: Directly cross-references GSC query rankings and impressions with GA4 reader engagement time and conversions per URL.

📝 Classic Editor & Productivity Power Tools (FREE)

  • Pro Table of Contents (TOC): 4 elegant styles (Bullets, Numbers, Minimal, Boxed) with smooth-scrolling, live preview, and Google-friendly semantic markup.
  • Site-Wide Broken Link Checker: Fast, automated link audits inside the Tools menu.
  • Bulk Title Editor Suite: Batch find-and-replace, title suffix additions, and manual overrides.
  • Editor Enhancements: In-article Find & Replace, Smart Related Posts, Update Reminders, Toolbar Emoji Picker, Table Builder, and real-time Sidebar SEO Analysis.

Why Choose DominoPost?

  1. Lightweight & Fast: Modular architecture built with zero bloat. Keeps your admin and site loading instantly.
  2. SEO-First Design: Engineered to boost organic rankings, maximize internal link equity, and improve search CTR.
  3. The Ultimate Classic Editor Alternative: If you love the speed and simplicity of the Classic Editor, DominoPost transforms it with modern React intelligence.
